evidence: Labeled 'Build system', modifies CMake compiler feature checks (cmake/module/CheckCXXFeatures.cmake) and CI environments to bump minimum GCC support to 13.
rationale: Bumping the minimum supported GCC version to 13 enables standard C++20 features like `std::format` and removes obsolete workarounds, but is reasonably deferrable compiler maintenance. As noted in the description, this change drops support for older vanilla systems shipping with GCC 12 while paving the way for future C++23 adoption.
